summary.text: Gina Johnsen is a Republican state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 78 and the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An insurance business owner, she is not seeking re-election to the House.

paragraphs.text: Gina Johnsen was born in Lansing, Michigan, and graduated from Lansing Eastern High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Wellesley College in 1989 and a master's degree in economics from Wellesley College.
Her career experience includes owning an insurance business and working as a life and health insurance agent.
Johnsen has served as director of the Michigan Capitol House of Prayer and on the advisory board of directors of Protect Life Michigan.
In the House, Johnsen's 2025 and 2026 assignments are the Families, Children, and Seniors, Judiciary, and Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation committees.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she listed education, health and the judiciary as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
Her key messages that year included that parents are in charge of their children, lower taxes and a better business environment, and safe communities and sustainable infrastructure.
